integrity: The algebraic series and all-length proof are supplied. Finite standard-library verification is reproducibility support, not proof by enumeration.
scientific_limitations: Exact for binary one-sided normal-play deletion of nonempty Dyck suffixes. No claim for misere play, two-ended moves, arbitrary context-free languages, or nonuniform random sources. Historical priority may be affected by unindexed equivalent work.
title: A Catalan–geometric law for Dyck-suffix subtraction games
